description: Render captions onto a local video, entirely on this machine. Needs the add-on `captionseasy-render` (returns ADDON_MISSING with the install command if absent). Give `words` / `words_file`; without them the video is transcribed first (needs the add-on `captionseasy-transcribe`). mode "burn" (default) writes an MP4 with captions and the original audio; mode "overlay" writes only the captions on a transparent background, same size/length as the video: overlay_format "mov" (ProRes 4444, default, every NLE) or "webm" (VP9 alpha, small). `overrides`/`settings` as in build_captions. Returns { out, durationMs, width, height, look, words, renderMs }. Takes roughly real time to a few times real time.

look.description: Look number (e.g. 12) or id (e.g. "hormozi_box"), from list_looks

out.description: Output path (default: next to the video)

overrides.description: Style changes, keys from describe_look controls (flat dot paths), e.g. {"active.color": "#FF3366", "fontSize": 80, "position.y": 0.8}

settings.description: Pacing changes, keys from describe_look settings, e.g. {"maxWordsPerCard": 2}

video.description: Absolute path of the local video file

words.description: Timed words, milliseconds on the video's clock

name: caption_video
title: Caption a video file
